links.what: ALGAR, the Algarve's waste operator, built EcoRouteAI with the Portuguese AI startup NILG.AI to choose sites for recycling points.
links.ai_path: The tool is machine learning on collection records and street and satellite imagery.

links.what: In 2022 the summit opened at the University of the Algarve's Campus da Penha (Faro) and continued the next day at NERA in Loule, so it ties Faro's university to Loule's business association. Algarve Evolution, Algarve STP, CCDR Algarve and the national innovation agency took part in the opening. AI appeared as a theme in one talk only: an old edition, not 2026.

links.what: Dengun runs a founders programme; its 2025 pitch day (30 January 2025, Le Club, Albufeira) had 12 startups chosen from about 400 applicants, finalists able to seek up to 300,000 euros. AI is one of the sectors covered.

links.source_title: Startups tecnologicas internacionais apresentam projetos a investidores em Albufeira (Barlavento)

links.ai_path: University partner of a programme with AI among its sectors.

to.name: ePaper urban management platform, with an AI online-service module

links.what: In July 2026 the council began a phased roll-out of an urban management platform evolved from ePaper, with a module that uses AI to check documents at submission and flag what is missing. About 5,000 licensing requests a year; seven in ten dispatches of its case section are correction requests. The article does not name a vendor.
links.ai_path: The council uses an AI module in licensing.
links.source_title: Portimao usa inteligencia artificial para agilizar urbanismo (Barlavento)
